features.name: Phantom
features.summary: Bond with a phantom whose emotional focus determines its skills, abilities, and manifestations.

features.name: Etheric Tether
features.summary: Keep the manifested phantom bound within a limited distance.

features.name: Shared Consciousness
features.summary: While the phantom resides in your consciousness, gain mental protection and its Skill Focus feats.

features.name: Bonded Manifestation
features.summary: Partially manifest the phantom through your body for defensive and offensive benefits.

features.name: Spiritual Interference
features.summary: The phantom protects nearby allies with a shield bonus to AC and saving throws.

features.name: Detect Undead
features.summary: Detect undead at will and gain improved awareness of haunts.

features.name: Phantom Recall
features.summary: Call your manifested phantom back to your side a limited number of times per day.

features.name: Fused Consciousness
features.summary: Retain shared-consciousness benefits while the phantom is manifested.

features.name: Spiritual Bond
features.summary: Transfer damage between yourself and your phantom to keep either partner standing.

features.name: Dual Bond
features.summary: Gain the benefits of bonded manifestation while the phantom remains separately manifested.

features.name: Empowered Consciousness
features.summary: The phantom permanently strengthens your mind and can return quickly after destruction.
